text: Shareable open link: an Aimparency URL that opens a Git repo read-only
description: A link such as http://localhost:4000/?repo=<git-url> opens that repository read-only directly, so maintainers can put a 'view the idea graph' link in a README and Aimparency users reach it in one click. Depends on opening from a Git URL. Viewers still run Aimparency locally; a public hosted viewer is out of scope unless decided separately.

status.comment:
?repo=<git url> link works in the running app; awaiting acceptance (and a decision whether to put the link in this repo's README).

project-store getRepoUrlParam/setRepoUrlParam; App onMounted: a ?repo= parameter wins over ?project= and runs the Git-URL open flow (clone or fetch, read-only); after opening, repo stays in the address next to project so the URL stays shareable and reloads refresh; opening a local path or closing deletes it. Evidence: navigated the running app to http://localhost:4000/?repo=https://github.com/aimparency/v7.git -> opened 790 ideas with the read-only badge, address kept repo=...; vue-tsc clean; pnpm check 25/25. Not done: a README link for this repo (Felix's call) and a hosted viewer (out of scope by design).
